company.name: 台達電子工業股份有限公司 _DELTA ELECTRONICS INC.

description.text:
About the job
Advanced technology team in Delta's CTO Office acts as an engine of innovation, discovering new technologies for business applications. Their core mission is to cultivate Delta's long-term capabilities by synergizing technological advancements with considerations for sustainable competitiveness.
【Responsibilities】
▶Lead LLM research and development of LLM techniques, including agentic AI, fine-tuning strategies, and novel algorithm and framework development.
▶Discover, implement, and validate State-of-the-Art (SOTA) methods for optimizing domain-specific AI systems to drive cost-effective performance and efficiency.
▶Collaborate with the development teams and business units to assess the feasibility and drive the adoption of new AI technologies.
▶Take leadership of driving innovation and delivery, from Proof of Concept (PoC) to successful technology deployment.
